notes:
- **Ratings now follow what you've actually watched.** The page opens on the
  movies and series you've started or finished — there's an "Only watched"
  toggle to widen it to everything — and each one shows a watched pill and a
  Mark-watched button, just like the dashboard. Series ratings are tucked into
  an expandable group per show, so the whole-series and per-season scores live
  together under the series name instead of floating as bare "Season 0" rows.
- **New "Suggestions / Fixes" section.** Spotted a bug or have an idea? Leave a
  note from the sidebar. Everyone can send one; the admin sees them all as a
  checklist and ticks off what's handled.
